crossRefs.note: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,
Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

people.name: Ahira
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Exodus

people.name: Enan
people.line: Father of Ahira, a leader of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
translations.bsb: and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
translations.kjv: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
translations.asv: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.
